perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.description: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.description: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

enhanced.description: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed for an improved duration.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

enhanced.name: To the Pain
enhanced.description:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage greatly increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Perfect Float
enhanced.description: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne accuracy and reduces flinch until you are out of combat for an extended duration.

enhanced.name: Destabilizing Rounds
enhanced.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for an improved duration.

enhanced.name: Adagio
